__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Existing Prometheus datasource
__inputs.description: Select the existing Prometheus datasource that scrapes the CWO exporter.

description: CWO-associated Codex sessions and agents, optional workflow audit events, and separately observed app-server dispatches. Whole-session usage remains distinct from CWO-only cost.

panels.title: Session scan
panels.description: Whole-profile session source scan age and coverage. Partial means files are pending or gaps/errors are present. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

panels.title: Audit scan
panels.description: Configured audit file scan age and availability, across all audit logs. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

panels.title: Dispatch telemetry
panels.description: Ledger health for all observed-dispatch sources at the range end. An idle job stream can still be healthy. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

panels.title: Publication backlog
panels.description: Terminal dispatches still awaiting exact-series publication confirmation. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

panels.title: Agents working
panels.description: Active workers in the selected work. Zero means observed work has finished; missing history stays unavailable. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: count(count by (project_id, agent_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_info{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) and on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) <= 2))) or (0 * count(last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_info{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Completed tasks
panels.description: [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: count((max by (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]))) == 3) or (0 * count((max by (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range])))))

panels.title: Stopped or failed
panels.description: Stopped, failed or disconnected tasks in the selected history. These are outcomes, not necessarily unresolved problems. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: count(((max by (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]))) == 4) or ((max by (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]))) == 5) or ((max by (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]))) == 6)) or (0 * count((max by (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range])))))

panels.title: Tokens reported
panels.description: Sum of reported total usage. Missing usage is excluded and remains visible in the work table. This is not a billing estimate. Token scale: K = thousand; Mil = million; Bil = billion; Tri = trillion. Tables show exact counts. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: sum((last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_observed_tokens{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="total"}[$__range]) and on (project_id, dispatch_id, token_kind) ((last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="total"}[$__range]) == 1) or (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="total"}[$__range]) == 2) or (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="total"}[$__range]) == 4))) unless on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_coverage_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) == 3))

panels.title: Work and results
panels.description: Observed dispatches matching Project and Task. Last response is the latest recorded model response timestamp. Jobs without a response remain in the table with a dash. Model and effort are requested values; acknowledgements are in Technical details. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: max by (dispatch_id) ((last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_observed_tokens{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="total"}[$__range]) and on (project_id, dispatch_id, token_kind) ((last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="total"}[$__range]) == 1) or (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="total"}[$__range]) == 2) or (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="total"}[$__range]) == 4))) unless on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_coverage_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) == 3))

panels.title: Where tokens went
panels.description: Reported token usage by task. Tasks without usage are excluded from this comparison and marked Not reported in the work table. Token scale: K = thousand; Mil = million; Bil = billion; Tri = trillion. Tables show exact counts. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: topk(10, max by (dispatch_id) ((last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_observed_tokens{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="total"}[$__range]) and on (project_id, dispatch_id, token_kind) ((last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="total"}[$__range]) == 1) or (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="total"}[$__range]) == 2) or (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",token_kind="total"}[$__range]) == 4))) unless on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_coverage_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) == 3)))

panels.title: Time spent by task
panels.description: Elapsed task time from the controller clock. This is wall time, not model compute time or an estimate of time remaining. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: topk(10, max by (dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_elapsed_seconds{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) and on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_field_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",field="dispatch_elapsed"}[$__range]) == 1)))

panels.title: Workflow events by type
panels.description: Unique source-time events by type across all configured audit logs. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: topk(10, count by (event_type) (((max by (event_id, event_type) (last_over_time(cwo_audit_event_timestamp_seconds[$__range])) >= ($__from / 1000)) and (max by (event_id, event_type) (last_over_time(cwo_audit_event_timestamp_seconds[$__range])) <= ($__to / 1000)))))

panels.title: Sessions with CWO
panels.description: Sessions with a structured CWO skill block or supported CWO helper command, and activity in the selected range. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: count(max by (project_id, session_id) ((cwo_codex_session_info{kind="session"} and on (project_id, session_id) (((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_cwo_association_timestamp_seconds) <= ($__to / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds >= ($__from / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds <= ($__to / 1000))) and on (project_id, session_id) max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_info))))) or (0 * (min(last_over_time(cwo_codex_cwo_scan_ready[2m])) == 1))

panels.title: Associated agents
panels.description: Subagent sessions associated directly or through a CWO-associated parent before their creation, with activity in the selected range. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: count(max by (project_id, session_id) ((cwo_codex_session_info{kind="subagent"} and on (project_id, session_id) (((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_cwo_association_timestamp_seconds) <= ($__to / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds >= ($__from / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds <= ($__to / 1000))) and on (project_id, session_id) max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_info))))) or (0 * (min(last_over_time(cwo_codex_cwo_scan_ready[2m])) == 1))

panels.title: Recorded session tokens
panels.description: Whole-session recorded token totals for the selected CWO-associated sessions and agents. Includes earlier session history; this is not CWO-exclusive cost. Missing or conflicting usage is omitted, so the total can be a lower bound. Token scale: K = thousand; Mil = million; Bil = billion; Tri = trillion. Tables show exact counts. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: sum((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_usage_tokens{token_kind="total"}) and on (project_id, session_id) (((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_cwo_association_timestamp_seconds) <= ($__to / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds) >= ($__from / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds) <= ($__to / 1000))) and on (project_id, session_id) max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_info))) and on (project_id, session_id) (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_usage_state) == 1))

panels.title: CWO helper commands
panels.description: Recorded completed command items invoking a supported CWO helper within the selected range. Includes failed attempts; separate from model jobs and audit preparations. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: count((max by (project_id, session_id, observation_id, tool, outcome) (cwo_codex_cwo_command_timestamp_seconds) >= ($__from / 1000)) and (max by (project_id, session_id, observation_id, tool, outcome) (cwo_codex_cwo_command_timestamp_seconds) <= ($__to / 1000))) or (0 * (min(last_over_time(cwo_codex_cwo_scan_ready[2m])) == 1))

panels.title: CWO-associated session activity
panels.description: CWO-associated sessions across the whole profile. Project and Task filters apply only to observed dispatches. Association comes from a skill block, supported helper command or associated parent. Tokens cover whole sessions, including work outside CWO. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: label_replace(label_join((max by (project_id, session_id, kind, model, effort) (cwo_codex_session_info) and on (project_id, session_id) (((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_cwo_association_timestamp_seconds) <= ($__to / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds) >= ($__from / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds) <= ($__to / 1000))) and on (project_id, session_id) max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_info))), "model_effort", " · ", "model", "effort"), "project", "$1", "project_id", "(.+)")

(max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_state) and on (project_id, session_id) (((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_cwo_association_timestamp_seconds) <= ($__to / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds) >= ($__from / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds) <= ($__to / 1000))) and on (project_id, session_id) max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_info)))

(max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_usage_tokens{token_kind="total"}) and on (project_id, session_id) (((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_cwo_association_timestamp_seconds) <= ($__to / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds) >= ($__from / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds) <= ($__to / 1000))) and on (project_id, session_id) max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_info))) and on (project_id, session_id) (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_usage_state) == 1)

1000 * (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds) and on (project_id, session_id) (((max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_cwo_association_timestamp_seconds) <= ($__to / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds) >= ($__from / 1000)) and on (project_id, session_id) (max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_last_event_timestamp_seconds) <= ($__to / 1000))) and on (project_id, session_id) max by (project_id, session_id) (cwo_codex_session_info)))

panels.title: Requested and configured models
panels.description: Requested settings come from the dispatch packet. Configured settings are populated only when acknowledged by the runtime. A dash means no acknowledged value is available. Raw project and dispatch IDs support source lookup. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

panels.title: Observed token totals with provenance
panels.description: Only present, runtime-normalized, or partial latest values render. State 2 means upstream presence is unknown for optional subsets, including nonzero values. Coverage conflict suppresses numeric totals. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/). Runtime-normalized; upstream presence unknown means the runtime supplied a normalized value without confirming that the upstream response included it.

targets.expr: (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_observed_tokens{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) and on (project_id, dispatch_id, token_kind) ((last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) == 1) or (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) == 2) or (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_token_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) == 4))) unless on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_coverage_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) == 3)

panels.title: Cycle allowance and enforced tool ceiling
panels.description: Declared completed-cycle allowance and derived use are display-only. The enforced tool-call ceiling is a separate authoritative unit. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_declared_cycle_remaining{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) and on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_field_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",field="declared_cycle_allowance"}[$__range]) == 1) and on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_coverage_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) == 1)

last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_declared_cycle_overrun{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) and on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_field_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",field="declared_cycle_allowance"}[$__range]) == 1) and on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_coverage_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) == 1)

panels.title: Elapsed allowance and enforced runtime ceiling
panels.description: Elapsed values require qualified supervisor timing. Declared elapsed allowance and enforced runtime ceiling remain separate. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

targets.expr: last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_declared_elapsed_remaining_seconds{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) and on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_field_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",field="declared_elapsed_allowance"}[$__range]) == 1) and on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_field_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",field="dispatch_elapsed"}[$__range]) == 1)

last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_declared_elapsed_overrun_seconds{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch"}[$__range]) and on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_field_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",field="declared_elapsed_allowance"}[$__range]) == 1) and on (project_id, dispatch_id) (last_over_time(cwo_dispatch_field_state{project_id=~"$project",dispatch_id=~"$dispatch",field="dispatch_elapsed"}[$__range]) == 1)

panels.title: CWO files pending
panels.description: Files awaiting CWO history scanning. Counts are lower bounds during backfill. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

panels.title: CWO source gaps
panels.description: Malformed or oversized candidate records, conflicting observations, or source access failures. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

panels.title: Audit source errors
panels.description: File or directory access failures in the latest scan. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).

panels.title: Skipped audit records
panels.description: Records omitted from the latest scan. Query cwo_audit_skipped_records by reason for details. [Reading the Values](https://turbra.github.io/traceonaut/dashboards/reading-values/).
